Subject: Fwd: Activation lifecycle timeline & next steps — internal owners & MAP finalization

Folks — forwarding Claire's confirmation. Below is the internal mutual action plan I propose to finalize and send back to HelioWorks today. Please review and call out any edits inline. I want to lock owners and dates by EOD so we can update the spreadsheet.

Summary (single-line): 6-week activation plan with procurement PO target 2026-07-28 and production cutover 2026-09-06. We will operate under a staged rollback policy and provide a pre-cutover dry run.

Proposed mutual action plan (milestones, owner, target date, acceptance criteria):
- Milestone 0 — Provisioning & Access
  - Owner: Jordan Blake (Platform Ops)
  - Target: 2026-07-26
  - Acceptance: Customer can authenticate to sandbox, API keys issued, IP allowlist completed.
- Milestone 1 — Integration tests (functional)
  - Owner: Ben Carter (Customer Success lead)
  - Target: 2026-08-02
  - Acceptance: 90% of sanity checks pass, basic end-to-end flows demonstrated.
- Milestone 2 — Performance validation (load and latency)
  - Owner: Jordan Blake
  - Target: 2026-08-16
  - Acceptance: 99th-percentile latency <= 250ms for sample workload; throughput target met.
- Milestone 3 — Customer acceptance QA window
  - Owner: Ben Carter (coordinate with HelioWorks QA)
  - Target: 2026-08-23 to 2026-08-30 (one-week window)
  - Acceptance: Customer sign-off via acceptance checklist in Drive (link below).
- Milestone 4 — Production cutover
  - Owner: Jordan Blake (runbook execution), Ben Carter (stakeholder comms)
  - Target: 2026-09-06
  - Acceptance: Traffic routing switched, rollback plan verified, post-cutover monitoring green for 48 hours.

Contingency & buffers:
- Procurement delay buffer: if PO slips past 2026-07-28, push Milestone 0 by up to 2 weeks and re-run integration window.
- Security questionnaire: Security Q&A must be returned by 2026-07-25 to keep timeline; otherwise, enable limited sandbox access for functional verification.

Communication cadence / handoffs:
- Weekly 30-minute sync every Tuesday 09:00 PT starting 2026-07-28 (Ben/Jordan/Claire).
- Pre-cutover dry run scheduled one week prior to cutover (target week of 2026-08-30).
- Escalation: if high-severity perf issues arise, page Jordan and Soojin; Ben will notify Claire and HelioWorks stakeholders.

Action items for this thread (owners):
- Jordan: confirm provisioning checklist and estimate for IP allowlist change (due 2026-07-21).
- Ben: update the MAP spreadsheet with owners and push to Drive (due 2026-07-19 EOD).
- Soojin: prepare the acceptance checklist doc and send final MAP to HelioWorks once owners are confirmed (due 2026-07-19 EOD).

Please reply with any objections. If silent by 17:00 PT I will assume sign-off and send the final MAP to Claire.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee | Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
